div.div: حَبْلٌ مَشْزُورٌ A rope, or cord, twisted from the left; (Lth, A, Msb, TA;) which is the stronger way: (Lth, A:) or upwards: (As, T, S:) [see 1:] and ↓ غَدَائِرُ مُسْتَشْزِرَاتٌ , (S, TA,) and ↓ مُسْتَشْزَرَاتٌ , (TA,) [Pendent locks of hair] so twisted. (S, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
